description: The workshop's shipped global agent configuration, installed onto a machine by adopt-global-rules. Three kinds: a per-host global instruction document (globals/), discrete single-source rules fanned out to every host (rules/), and output styles for hosts that have a first-class surface for them (output-styles/). Paths are relative to the skill directory; targets are relative to the home directory (or to --root). This is plugin payload; it ships with the plugin the same way its skills do, and changes to it are released, not configured per machine.
